Key Features of Variable Speed Assistants:
Adaptation to Your Swing
Compared to fixed speed training aids, the VSA is unique because it adapts to the golfer. Left-handed or right-handed golfers can easily choose their preferred shot shape, while male or female golfers can select which grip works best for them.
Simulated Shots
Various shot simulations are available for both driving and putting. Amateur students can choose their normal shot shape, while professional coaches can set the flight parameters and ball speed for high-level instruction and analysis.
